announcements.title: Free Computer & Digital Skills Course (CDSC)
announcements.body: A free live online course for visually impaired learners starts 17 August, covering computer fundamentals, the internet, email, Microsoft Office, AI productivity, and more.

announcements.title: Mentorship Programme
announcements.body: Open now — students, professionals, and parents can get guidance from experienced mentors and subject experts. Fill in the form on the programme page to request mentorship.
